abilities.name: Quest Board Instinct
abilities.description: Read the guild board and you can sense which posted job is worse than it looks.
abilities.cost: Only works on jobs posted that morning

growth.grows: how well hidden the danger can be

abilities.name: Camp Craft
abilities.description: When you make camp, you can set it so that anyone approaching wakes you before they reach the fire.
abilities.cost: Takes an hour of setup; useless in towns

growth.grows: how quiet an approach still wakes you

abilities.name: Party Rhythm
abilities.description: After one fight beside the same allies, you can call one move they will follow without words.
abilities.cost: Needs a full fight together first

growth.grows: how many moves and how many allies

abilities.name: Monster Butcher
abilities.description: Cut a monster carcass and you can take its most valuable part without spoiling it.
abilities.cost: A messy hour; the smell draws scavengers

growth.grows: how rare a monster and how many parts

abilities.name: Trap Feel
abilities.description: Touch a floor tile or chest and sense whether it is trapped, though not how.

growth.grows: how well hidden a trap and whether you sense the kind

abilities.name: Rank Bluff
abilities.description: Speak like a higher-rank adventurer and townsfolk believe your guild rank is one step higher than it is.
abilities.cost: A real higher-rank adventurer sees through it

growth.grows: how many ranks you can claim

abilities.name: Potion Stretcher
abilities.description: You can split one healing potion between two people and each gets most of its effect.
abilities.cost: Both drinkers feel sick for an hour

growth.grows: how many people can share one potion

abilities.name: Bounty Nose
abilities.description: Hold a wanted poster and you can sense the direction of the person on it, if they are within a day's walk.
abilities.cost: The poster must be the real one, not a copy

abilities.name: Sure Grip Climb
abilities.description: Climb a cliff or wall with poor holds as if every hold were good, until you rest.
abilities.cost: Forearms burn; you must rest before the next climb

growth.grows: how sheer a face and how long you can climb

abilities.name: Guild Discount
abilities.description: When you show your guild card at a supplier, you can get adventuring supplies cheaper than the posted price.
abilities.cost: Only at guild-friendly shops; they expect loyalty

growth.grows: how big the discount and how many shops

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Shout at a monster and it fixes on you instead of your weaker allies until it is hurt.
abilities.cost: It fixes on you with all its strength

growth.grows: how smart a monster it works on

abilities.name: Retreat Path
abilities.description: Before entering a dungeon you can mark a way out, and always find it again when you need to run.
abilities.cost: Only one path marked at a time

growth.grows: how deep a dungeon the path still works in
